name: logs_volume_spike_anomaly
title: Pod log volume spiked
description: The number of pod log lines per five-minute bucket in the default logs stream is above its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 buckets, a sign of a log storm or an ingest cost surprise. Unit: log lines per 5 minutes. Whole stream (all clusters, namespaces and pods); add a k8s_cluster or k8s_namespace_name filter after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity).
